highlights: Diluted EPS was $2.37 for the third quarter, and diluted EPS, adjusted for special items, was $2.45
Net income was $536 million for the third quarter
System-wide comparable RevPAR increased 5.8 percent, on a currency neutral basis, for the third quarter compared to the same period in 2025

Repurchased 2.6 million shares of Hilton common stock during the third quarter, bringing total capital return, including dividends, to $879 million for the quarter and $2,902 million year to date through October
For the three months ended September 30, 2026, system-wide comparable RevPAR increased 5.8 percent compared to the same period in 2025 due to an increase in both occupancy and ADR.

quotes.text: We delivered strong top and bottom-line results for the third quarter that exceeded our expectations. Our results were driven by momentum across our system, which we expect to continue for the remainder of the year and into 2027.

items.heading: We are subject to the business, financial and operating risks inherent to the hospitality industry, any of which could reduce our revenues and limit opportunities for growth.
Macroeconomic conditions, geopolitical activity, public health concerns and other factors beyond our control can adversely affect and reduce demand for our products and services.
Contraction in the global economy or low levels of economic growth could adversely affect our revenues and profitability, as well as limit or slow our future growth.
Because we operate in a highly competitive industry, our revenues or profits could be harmed if we are unable to compete effectively.
